scenePolicy: The cover is an artistic memory montage, not a claim that four events happened together.
Never assert accurate costumes, actual fireworks patterns, cave structure, or other details without real reference photographs.
Use only source-backed subjects explicitly selected by the trip owner.
Keep typography, labels, brands, maps and imaginary travel stops out of generated art.
Never claim photo fidelity without attributable rights-cleared reference photos.
